SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId,CustomerAccountName,CustomerAccountOpenedDate,CustomerAccountClosedDate,IsoCurrencyCode,SourceSystemCode,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,BRANCHID FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount) BCA --- 3,949,240
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct CAFP ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = CAFP.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId --- 3,949,240 / 3,948,556
LEFT JOIN BNKM.FinancialProductApplication FPA ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,CAFP.ProductId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,FPA.FinancialProductId) AND CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId --- 868,848 / 868,649
---LEFT JOIN BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNTFINANCIALPRODUCT BCAF ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCAF.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAF.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CoreCustomerAccount BCCACCT ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCACCT.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCACCT.FinancialInstitutionId --- 868,848 / 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.DepositAccountStatus BDAS ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BDAS.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BDAS.FinancialInstitutionId --- 868,848 / 868,649
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL BCCA ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID --- 868,848 / 868,649
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = DDB.BANKID --- 868,649 / 3948556
WHERE BCA.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
AND CAFP.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%')
AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBRAN ON BCA.BRANCHID = DDBRAN.BRANCHID AND DDBRAN.CurrentIndicator = 1 --- 2,863,201
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter BCCC ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCC.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCCC.ProfitCostCenterTypeId = 'Account PCC Code 1' --- 2,863,201


SELECT FcbsApplicationId, COUNT(*) from BNKM.FinancialProductApplication WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' GROUP BY FcbsApplicationId 



SELECT FcbsApplicationId, COUNT(*)
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId,CustomerAccountName,CustomerAccountOpenedDate,CustomerAccountClosedDate,IsoCurrencyCode,SourceSystemCode,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,BRANCHID FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount) BCA --- 3,949,240
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct CAFP ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = CAFP.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId --- 3,949,240
LEFT JOIN BNKM.FinancialProductApplication FPA ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,CAFP.ProductId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,FPA.FinancialProductId) AND CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId --- 868,848
WHERE BCA.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' GROUP BY FcbsApplicationId
